title: Covid-19 qPCR Prep (Station C)
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather consumables and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all required items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.21.0 or later), Temperature Module with Aluminum Block Set, P300 Single‑Channel GEN2 pipette, P20 Multi‑Channel GEN2 pipette, Opentrons filter tips, NEST PCR plate (0.1 mL, 96‑well, full‑skirt), 2 mL NEST screw‑cap tubes (or equivalent), and purified RNA elution plate.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mix in tube
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel pipette, dispense the required reagents into a 2 mL NEST screw‑cap tube to create the qPCR master mix.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix to PCR strip
steps.instruction: Distribute the prepared reaction mix from the 2 mL tube into the wells of a PCR strip using the single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Add RNA samples to qPCR plate
steps.instruction: With the 8‑channel (multi‑channel) pipette, transfer each purified RNA sample from the elution plate to the corresponding well of the NEST PCR plate and mix with the aliquoted master mix.

steps.title: Upload protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle, then upload any custom labware definitions if needed, followed by the protocol itself into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the robot deck as specified in the provided deck map, placing the PCR plate, tip racks, tube, and any modules in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip racks, and both pipettes using the supplied calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the qPCR preparation protocol.
